slug: 2026-04-13 WATRA rallies Africa for region's $216b digital economy

facts.fact: Burkina Faso's regulator ARCEP hosted the 4th Working Groups Meeting of WATRA, the West Africa Telecommunications Regulators Assembly (16 member states), in Ouagadougou, concluding on 2026-04-12 (the article of 13 April says 'yesterday'), where the groups finalised reports on 5G, cable resilience, cybersecurity, consumer protection and NGSO satellites.

systems.tiers: national telecom regulators (ARCEP Burkina Faso hosted)
